study: Arabic faceless finance YouTube channel - forensic competitive study
objective: Identify reproducible patterns behind successful finance/economics YouTube channels (Arabic and international) that a small faceless whiteboard channel can realistically execute.

legal_and_ethical_scope.data_used: Public metadata only, retrieved through the official YouTube Data API v3 under Google's Terms of Service.
legal_and_ethical_scope.thumbnails: Referenced by public URL only; not redistributed.
legal_and_ethical_scope.captions: Availability flag only via captions.list metadata; caption text is not downloaded.
legal_and_ethical_scope.copying_policy: No titles, thumbnails, scripts or structures are reproduced. Only abstracted, reusable patterns are extracted.

environment_constraints.youtube_com_web: BLOCKED by this session's network egress policy
environment_constraints.third_party_stats_sites: BLOCKED (vidiq.com, socialblade.com, playboard.co, noxinfluencer.com all denied)
environment_constraints.support_google_com: BLOCKED - YouTube policy pages could not be fetched live in this session
environment_constraints.youtube_googleapis_com: REACHABLE - the sole viable data source
environment_constraints.consequence: All quantitative findings derive from the YouTube Data API v3. Any statement that could not be sourced from it is labelled OPINION or UNVERIFIED in the report.

phase_1_discovery.method: search.list (type=channel) across 24 targeted queries, tagged by bucket A/B/C/D, with relevanceLanguage and regionCode varied across EG/SA/AE/MA/JO/US/GB.
phase_1_discovery.rationale: Channels are surfaced by the platform's own index rather than recalled from memory, so the candidate set is reproducible and dated.

buckets.B: Arabic trading, crypto, gold, stocks, market analysis
buckets.D: International faceless, animated, whiteboard explainer finance

phase_1_discovery.exclusion_rule: Channels with no upload in the last 180 days are excluded unless retained as a documented format lesson, in which case they are flagged inactive_lesson=true.

phase_2_collection.evidence: Every raw API response is archived unmodified to evidence/raw_api/ with its request parameters and a UTC collection timestamp.
phase_2_collection.missing_data_handling: NULL is stored and reported as 'not disclosed'. Hidden subscriber counts, hidden likes and disabled comments are recorded as flags, never imputed.

age_bias_controls.maturity_filter: Cross-video comparisons use only videos >= 30 days old, because view accrual is heavily front-loaded and a 3-day-old video is not comparable to a 2-year-old one.
age_bias_controls.views_per_day: Reported as a rate alongside raw views.
age_bias_controls.cohort_index: Each video is scored against the median of videos from the SAME channel in the SAME calendar quarter. This is the primary fair comparison; cohorts with fewer than 4 videos are dropped.

definitions.is_short: duration <= 180s. HEURISTIC: the API does not expose a definitive Shorts flag, so some short long-form videos may be misclassified. Flagged as an estimate.
definitions.median_preferred_over_mean: View distributions are heavily right-skewed; the mean is dragged by single viral videos.
definitions.pct_outperform_2x: Share of mature videos with views >= 2x the channel median.
definitions.top10pct_view_share: Share of total views held by the top decile of videos - measures whether a channel lives off a few viral hits.
definitions.gini_views: 0 = every video performs equally, 1 = total concentration.
definitions.views_per_sub: channel median views / subscriber count. A reach-efficiency proxy, NOT a quality measure.
definitions.engagement_rate: likes / views. NULL where the channel hides likes.

known_limitations: The API returns lifetime view counts only - no watch time, CTR, retention or impressions. All of those are private analytics and are NOT estimated here.
Upload TIME analysis uses publishedAt in UTC. Audience-local timing cannot be derived without private analytics, so time-of-day findings are correlational and weak.

The API cannot report whether a presenter shows their face, or whether whiteboard animation is used. Those fields require human review of thumbnails/videos and are coded manually with the coder and date recorded.

search.list ranking is personalised and time-varying; a rerun on another date may surface a different candidate set. The query list and date are recorded so the run is at least documented, not silently irreproducible.

evidence_separation.FACT: Retrieved verbatim from the YouTube Data API and archived in evidence/raw_api/.
evidence_separation.CALCULATION: Deterministically derived from FACTs by scripts/analyze.py.
evidence_separation.ESTIMATE: Rule-based inference such as subject classification or the Shorts heuristic.
evidence_separation.OPINION: Analyst judgement, including all creative and strategic recommendations.

phase_6_whiteboard.rule: draw the idea, screenshot the evidence
